rows.what_the_ink_shows: The opening assertion visibly ends qui n'est pas une variete abelienne (crops/55_scan017_L921_assertion.png). The example then identifies T as the quotient of C^2 by the group Gamma generated by the displayed list (crops/55_scan017_L921_quotient.png). That list clearly reads e_1, i e_1, e_2, e_1+i k e_2: the fourth term begins with the same bare e_1 shape as the first term and has no lambda or other coefficient before it (crops/55_scan017_L921_generators.png). The next line writes avec k irrationnel, with irrationnel underlined (crops/55_scan017_L921_irrational.png).
rows.note: Preserve the four written generators $e_1,ie_1,e_2,e_1+ike_2$, the irrationality condition, and the assertion for which this is offered as an example. The supplied mathematical correction says that this particular T is actually $\mathbf C/(\mathbf Z+i\mathbf Z)\times\mathbf C/(\mathbf Z+ik\mathbf Z)$, hence an abelian variety, since the fourth generator minus the first yields $ike_2$. It proposes replacing the fourth generator by $\lambda e_1+ike_2$ with a suitable lambda making the extension non-split up to isogeny. No lambda is visible in the manuscript. This is an editorial repair of the example, not a transcription correction; the supplied lattice/proof criticism was not independently re-proved.
